description: The Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme is implemented by the Social Welfare Department, Government of Bihar. The scheme provides monthly financial assistance to leprosy patients suffering from Visible Deformities Grade-II. It is fully funded by the Government of Bihar with the objective of ensuring financial support and social security to eligible beneficiaries.
objectives: Provide financial assistance to leprosy patients with Visible Deformities Grade-II.
Improve the social security and quality of life of affected individuals.
Support economically vulnerable leprosy patients in Bihar.

benefits.title: Monthly Financial Assistance
benefits.description: Eligible beneficiaries receive financial assistance of ₹1,500 per month.

eligibility.title: Residence
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a resident of Bihar.

eligibility.title: Medical Condition
eligibility.description: The applicant must be a leprosy patient diagnosed with Visible Deformities Grade-II.

application_steps.title: Obtain Application Form
application_steps.description: Collect the prescribed application form from the concerned Block Office.

application_steps.title: Fill the Application
application_steps.description: Complete the application form and attach all the required supporting documents.

application_steps.title: Submit Application
application_steps.description: Submit the completed application at the respective Block Office.

application_steps.title: Verification and Approval
application_steps.description: The Block Development Officer verifies the application and approves eligible cases.

documents_required.name: Identity Proof
documents_required.remarks: Voter ID Card, Driving Licence, or any valid government-issued identity proof.

documents_required.name: Medical Reports / Grade-II Visible Deformities Certificate
documents_required.remarks: Medical documents confirming Visible Deformities Grade-II due to leprosy.

documents_required.name: Other Supporting Documents
documents_required.remarks: Any additional documents required by the concerned authority.

important_notes: The scheme is fully funded by the Government of Bihar.
Only leprosy patients with Visible Deformities Grade-II are eligible.
Applications are submitted offline at the concerned Block Office.
Applications are approved by the Block Development Officer (BDO).
Grievances can be submitted through the designated Social Welfare Department authorities under the Bihar Public Grievance Redressal Rights Act, 2016.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the Bihar Shatabdi Leper Welfare Scheme?
faqs.answer: Residents of Bihar diagnosed with leprosy and having Visible Deformities Grade-II.

faqs.question: How much financial assistance is provided?
How can I apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Applications must be submitted offline at the concerned Block Office in the prescribed format.

faqs.question: Who approves the application?
faqs.answer: The Block Development Officer (BDO) approves eligible applications.

faqs.question: Which documents are required?
faqs.answer: Aadhaar Card, passport-size photograph, identity proof, medical certificate showing Visible Deformities Grade-II, address proof, bank passbook, and other supporting documents if required.
